title: Apogee — Orbital Mission Lab
description: Fling satellites into orbit, plan impulsive burns against a live conic preview, solve Hohmann transfers and export the chart.
concept: A two-body orbital sandbox that behaves like a real mission console. Drag anywhere in the sky to slingshot a satellite, then read its osculating conic — apoapsis, periapsis, eccentricity, period — updating live from the state vector. Dial prograde and radial Δv and a green dashed ellipse shows exactly the orbit the burn would buy before you commit it; a Hohmann solver sizes both burns for any target radius, including the sync ring and the moonlet Selene. Ten flight badges, an atmosphere that eats low orbits, and PNG, JSON and share-link export of the whole sky.
features: Drag-to-launch: pull back anywhere in empty sky to set a satellite's speed and heading, with the resulting conic previewed live
Impulsive manoeuvre planner — prograde and radial Δv sliders with a dashed preview of the post-burn orbit and a per-craft Δv budget
Hohmann transfer solver: pick any target radius (or one tap for the sync ring / Selene's orbit) and it sizes Δv₁, Δv₂ and the coast time
Live orbital elements from the state vector — altitude, speed, apoapsis, periapsis, eccentricity, period, distance to the moonlet
Seven scenarios (parking orbit, GTO, Molniya, sync constellation, moonlet flyby, debris swarm, empty sky) plus a fleet of up to 24 craft
Exponential atmosphere below 190 km that decays low orbits, and a crater if you meet the ground
Ten flight badges saved to localStorage — make orbit, circularise, sync lock, Selene flyby, capture, escape, constellation, lithobraking
Export: PNG orbit chart with mission stats, scenario JSON download and re-import, and a share link that packs the whole sky into the URL

interaction.mouse: Drag from empty sky to fling a satellite; drag an existing craft to re-aim it; wheel to zoom; shift-drag or right-drag to pan
interaction.click: Tap a craft or a fleet row to select it; Execute burn applies the dialled Δv; the transfer solver loads Δv₁ or Δv₂ for you
interaction.touch: One finger drags to launch and re-aim, two fingers pinch to zoom and pan, tabbed bottom panel holds fleet, burns, badges and export
interaction.keyboard: Space pauses, W/S/A/D fire live thrust at 220 m/s per second, 1–8 set time warp, F frames everything, Tab cycles craft, Del scuttles one
